articles.title: 400 Buildings That Pollute More Than a Whole Country
articles.summary: A Harvard study finds America's 400 largest data centers release more greenhouse gas in a year than Denmark, and the real total may be even higher.

articles.title: She Retired to Care for Family. New Food-Aid Rules Got in the Way
articles.summary: After 40 years of work, Lisa Reese retired at 62 to care for family, but new SNAP work rules mean she must volunteer 80 hours a month to keep $63 in food aid.

articles.title: Lake Ontario or Lake America? Tribal Leaders Say: Keep the Name
articles.summary: The National Congress of American Indians is asking President Trump to reverse his order renaming Lake Ontario, saying the name carries Indigenous history.
